title: InsurVision - Intelligent Insurance Claim Analysis System
summary: Researchers at IIT Hyderabad are building InsurVision, a set of language-model agents meant to analyze insurance claims; faster settlements remain an intended benefit.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Shreesh Gupta and Arjit Gupta of IIT Hyderabad proposed InsurVision as a set of language-model agents that check policies, review photos, videos and documents, and decide claims. The team reports that its implementation plan is in progress. Faster settlements and disaster recovery remain intended benefits. The team planned pilots with insurers and disaster response agencies as future work.
purpose: Help insurers analyze claims more quickly and consistently.
model_version: GPT-4.1, Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemma 3 (listed as technology keywords)

data.answer:
IIT Hyderabad is developing InsurVision to analyze claims. Faster settlements and disaster recovery remain intended benefits, with implementation still in progress.

A development server and automated workflow do not establish faster settlement or improved disaster recovery. The entry supplies no real claims, payment accuracy, delay comparison, or claimant outcome and acknowledges unresolved model bias. Planned insurer pilots and deepfake detection remain future work.

The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.
